overall_reason: Motion is sparse and each motion has a job: the "About" menu fades and scales in over 150 ms (the sweep's easing hit on ease is a small drift on a quick menu), "How it works" scrolls to its section in about 390 ms, the theme toggle is instant, and the page arrives with a single 350 ms fade-up.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE, T-FREQUENCY and T-CHOREOGRAPHY pass (one page arrival, short menu feedback), and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds a mix of Tailwind defaults, linear and ease.

findings.title: One curve family and one duration scale
findings.evidence: 13 elements use Tailwind's cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) at 150 to 300 ms, 8 use linear at 100 ms for colour, 2 use cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), and the "About" menu opens on the browser default ease (sweep MOT-002 easing hit).
findings.before: Four curves for small colour and opacity changes, with no tokens.
findings.after: Use one exit curve, such as the cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) already in use, for the menu and the colour changes.
findings.why: The drift is small, but one curve family would make the menu and buttons feel related.

strengths: The "About" menu opens in 150 ms with an opacity and scale change measured to end at 148 ms, quick feedback that suits a nav menu.
The page arrives once (a single fade-up of 350 ms on the main column) with no per-section reveals at load.
